verdict.rationale: Bruno has no documented public API for driving the app, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Its programmatic surfaces are indirect: collections are stored as plain-text Bru files that the site says work with 'your agents', the bru CLI runs collections, and a `bru` JavaScript API exists, but only inside request scripts. Missing for 10: a documented public or external API (REST, SDK or local server) for controlling the product, an API reference or OpenAPI spec, and any independent or hands-on evidence of driving Bruno through an API.
